opening.argument: The speaker ties earnings directly to paid team participation, requiring “330 TRX for joining” while promising “double or triple profit.” The structure then expands through tiered contributions: viewers are told to buy TRX for one level and that “for level 2 trx you need 750 trx,” while profit is described as coming from another person’s joining money. The recruitment premise is reinforced by the claim that viewers will recover their 330 TRX “within 1 or 2 days” through three or four subscribers. This is not a neutral explanation of an opportunity; it is a solicitation built around escalating payments, successive recruitment, and rapid-profit promises, followed by a direction to use the description link and call to join and earn money.
